notes: Marfrig Global Foods (B3: MRFG3) — beef + processed protein, with controlling stake (~50.5%) in BRF S.A. (BRFS3). Two operating segments: National Beef (NA beef, 81.7% owned), and South America beef. Sold 16 plants to Minerva (BEEF3) in Aug 2024 for R$7.5bn (Brazil + Southern Cone). FY ends Dec 31. Consolidates BRF since 2H22 — drives revenue uplift and adds chicken/processed exposure.

periods.notes: FY20: Revenue R$67.9bn (pre-BRF consolidation), EBITDA R$9.3bn (margin 13.7%) — peak NA beef margins.
FY21: Revenue R$84.7bn, EBITDA R$16.1bn (margin 19.0%) — record year, peak NA beef cycle.
FY22: Revenue R$134.8bn (+59% — BRF consolidation from Aug 2022), EBITDA R$14.9bn (margin 11.1%) — NA beef cycle began rolling over.
FY23: Revenue R$134.6bn (flat). EBITDA R$9.3bn (margin 6.9%) — NA beef trough. Net loss R$3.2bn.
FY24: Revenue R$152.3bn (+13%), EBITDA R$13.7bn (margin 9.0%). Aug 2024 sale of 16 plants to Minerva for R$7.5bn deleveraged BS — net debt R$33.6bn (-20%). Net income recovered to R$720M.
